I nod. Hearing that Satono Crown and the others would be preparing late into the evening,
I brought snacks for the whole class as a little pick-me-up.

Mm-hmm~ You always do that, don't you? It's like you can foresee everything...
Guess it just shows how well you understand Cla-chan~

R-Right. Trainer has their own schedule, after all.
I need to ask ASAP!

...Still, right now, we need to focus on preparing for the event.
Come on, let's power through this final stretch!!

Look, the open campus event is coming up soon, right?
Our class is planning to run a food stall.

Weeell, I'm sure it'll be fine with your Trainer, but...
If you're going abroad, you'd better give 'em a heads-up, don'tcha think~?
'Kaaay. For now, I'll promote it on Umastagram and stuff~

I intend to do everything in my power so I can bring back good news!
Well, look forward to it, okay?

If all goes well, entering races over there
might yield brand-new breakthroughs, too...!

So today, we're having a class meeting to decide what kind of shop we'll run!
I'm planning to propose an egg tart stall.

It'll be fine! If we work together, we can definitely pull it off.
Come on, let's keep giving it our all for tomorrow!

Fufu! But you know... not quite yet!
We should be able to understand each other even more deeply than this.

Ah... that's right! Things will be a bit irregular for a while, so...
It'd really help if you could schedule things with an extra hour of leeway compared to usual!
Eh, Trainer...?! Zan hai?!

I'm totally down for that, but...
if you ask me, I'm kinda better at making signboards and stuff, y'know?

How could I have overlooked this...
I just took it for granted that we'd be going together.

Trainer! Sweet treats... as in refreshments?!
Whoa, they look delicious! Did you really bring these all the way here for us?

As for you... could I ask you to design our flyers?
I want you to grab everyone's attention with that signature eye-catching style of yours.

Hearing that they were setting up an egg tart stall,
I let her know that I had proactively shortlisted several food ingredient suppliers beforehand.

I get to hear everyone's carefully thought-out ideas while getting feedback on mine, too!
It's such a constructive event! How could I not be excited?♪

Flyers take time to print, so I want to get them made early.
I'll ask you to help with the signboard later too! Start brainstorming some ideas, okay?♪

Our training efficiency will improve,
and I can learn business under Father as well.
One day, I ran into Satono Crown walking with a cheerful spring in her step.

No way... this is top-tier support!
Thanks to you, we can definitely push through one more round!

Great! Thank you, that's a huge help...!
You just saved us so much time. I'll get right to negotiating—

All that's left is finding a supplier... That said, without any
connections in the food industry... I suppose we'll have to search from scratch—

...As for the budget, other classes mentioned running stalls as well...
If we combine our shipments with bulk orders, we can cut costs down...

In that case... could I ask you to spread the word about our egg tarts
both on and off campus? Just whatever you can manage will be plenty.

Still, you'd expect nothing less from Cla-chan's Trainer.
Showing up right at the exact moment we were craving something sweet!

I'm thinking of going to Hong Kong together during the upcoming long break.
Placing ourselves in the best possible environment will help us understand each other even better, right?

Going abroad long-term with your Trainer, huh...
That's pretty bold, but I'm surprised they agreed to it so easily~

Menu is done~! Now all that's left is the signboard~.
I wanna wrap this up before it gets dark~!

Later on, thanks to their hard work, the egg tart stall turned out
to be a massive success, reportedly drawing long lines of eager customers.
